Tuesday
Our team met in the library about the notes-sharing site for the campus. Vijay had a list of twelve features: upload, search, ratings, user profiles, comments, badges, dark mode, a leaderboard...
I asked the question I'd been thinking about all week: what's the smallest version that's actually useful? If someone can upload their notes and someone else can find them, that's the whole point. Everything else is nice but not needed on day one.
Vijay argued for ratings. "How will people know which notes are good?" Fair. But ratings need lots of users first, and we have zero.
In the end we agreed. Launch with upload and search only. Ratings, profiles and the rest go on a "later" list on the whiteboard. Target: live before mid-sems in three weeks.
I feel lighter. Twelve features felt impossible. Two feels doable.
Urmila
